reports.title: SENSATA TECHNOLOGIES REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, Sensata expects revenue of $942 to $972 million, inclusive of recovery of tariff costs, and adjusted EPS of $0.95 to $0.99.

$ in millions, except EPS | Q4-26 Guidance | Q4-25 | Y/Y Change
Revenue | $942 - $972 | $918 | 3% - 6%
Adjusted Operating Income | $185 - $192 | $180 | 3% - 7%
Adj. Operating Margin | 19.6% - 19.8% | 19.6% | 0 bps - 20 bps
Adjusted Net Income | $140 - $145 | $130 | 8% - 12%
Adjusted EPS | $0.95 - $0.99 | $0.88 | 8% - 13%
Tariff expectations included in guidance reflect trade policies in effect as of October 26, 2026, and do not include any impact from prospective tariff refunds.
